title: penstemon barbatus f. flaviflorus
intro: Penstemon barbatus f. flaviflorus, commonly known as Yellow Foxglove, is a plant species belonging to the Plantaginaceae family. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, which is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Foxglove include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
